correctness.rationale: Reconstructed the identities a.e. for the whole closed interval. The center branch sends I_(alpha-1) to I_(2alpha-2)/2. For g1, both summands contribute on the single center branch; writing c=alpha-1 and s=4-3alpha in [0,c], the two truncated right-branch images are (-c,s) and (-c,-s), and the reflected left images bring the total outer-image multiplicity to two on (-c,c). Thus Lg1=g0, and the inverse-branch formula gives Lg0=(g0+g1)/2. Both masses are 2alpha. The coefficient map t↦(1-t)/2 proves the alternating TV equality and the g0−g1 eigenmode; its disappearance at 3/2 is only in this span. The ++ cylinder begins at alpha/2+1/4≥2alpha−2 in the lowest-density region, giving a; symmetry, stationarity and the fixed one-letter masses give b,c. Opposite signs cannot follow one another and +++ is impossible, so positive ++ rules out first-order Markovity below 3/2. At 3/2 all allowed branch cylinders map onto the entire destination digit cell, so conditional uniformity inducts over any finite past. Direct differentiation gives log(ac/b²)/(2alpha²); the numerator of b²−ac has positive minimum on the interval. The entropy conclusion is only one-step. The frozen rational-grid checker was inspected, not run; it tests partitions and pairs but is not the continuum proof. RESULT.md line 47 should say two contributions on the one central inverse branch, not two central inverse branches; the identity is unaffected.
